name: openserv-laptop-parts
note: SVGO export config for the OpenServ laptop landing SVG layers. Run per-file; preserves stable top-level ids so CSS/WAAPI selectors (#screen, #keyboard, #hinge, #logic, #battery, #chassis, #assembled) stay deterministic.

exportRules.naming: one file per part; top-level id = part id
exportRules.viewport: viewBox 0 0 600 400 for every part (stage 1:1, aligns layers)
exportRules.style: ink (#000) strokes on white (#fff); logic/battery carry violet (#5f79ff) + mint (#01fe93) circuit strokes only; 16px corner radius on part clips
exportRules.transform: path-level transforms only; no nested rotated groups
exportRules.raster: no embedded raster; raster fallback assembled@2x.(webp|png) exported separately (400px tall, @2x = 800px)
exportRules.noUnused: do not remove defs referenced by other part svgs via <use>

fallbackMarkup.html: [data-part] elements in the template; data-part matches svg top-level id
